operations.name: Initiate person merge
operations.description: Initiate a person merge to combine a duplicate person profile into a primary person profile. This is an asynchronous process that will merge all data from the duplicate person into the primary person. Once the merge is initiated, you can track its progress using the returned task URL. Requires the "Manage duplicates" [permission](/pages/external-api-v2/permissions) and organization admin role.

primaryPersonId.description: The ID of the person profile that will be kept after the merge. All data from the duplicate person will be merged into this person.

duplicatePersonId.description: The ID of the person profile that will be merged and then deleted. All data from this person will be transferred to the primary person.

operations.description: | ⚠️ This endpoint is currently in BETA | |--| Search for Persons matching the given criteria. Accepts an optional combination of filters, sorts, and a search term. fieldTypes.description: A category of fields for which to return field data on each Person. Cannot be used together with `fieldIds`; use one or the other.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next or previous page.

totalCount.description: When `true`, includes the total count of matching Persons in the pagination response. Adds additional query cost; use only when needed.

filters.description: A logical group of filters combined with AND or OR. Groups can be nested to build complex filter trees. Each group may contain up to 50 items. Items can be individual filters or nested filter groups.

sorts.description: One or more sort criteria, applied in order. Supports up to 5 sort items. Use the relevant fields endpoint for your resource type to discover sortable fields.

search.description: A single keyword or phrase to match against field values. Multiple terms or comma-separated values are not supported; use a single search string.
